title: Quantitative estimates for the absolute convergence of wavelet-type series
summary: We establish new quantitative estimates for general systems of functions with wavelet-type dyadic structure. These estimates are applied to obtain the optimal growth of various types of Weyl multipliers for certain wavelet-type systems. Some of our results are sufficiently general to allow the orthogonality assumption to be removed.
